scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.ocr: powershell -Command "$p=(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8001 -EA SilentlyContinue).OwningProcess; if($p){Stop-Process -Id $p -Force -EA SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep 1}" && cd ocr_service && venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001
